articles.summary: MONTREAL–(BUSINESS WIRE)– AIRO Group Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: AIRO), a next-generation aerospace and defense company, today announced that Jaunt, its wholly owned Canadian subsidiary, has entered into a non-binding letter of intent with Vertiko Mobilité for the proposed purchase of 10 JC250 drones and a strategic collaboration to develop autonomous cargo logistics operations in Canada using […]
articles.title: AIRO Announces Jaunt–Vertiko Letter of Intent for Proposed Purchase of 10 JC250 Cargo Drones in Canada
